Tip: to feed this meter to the Karoo, pair the sensor named “KPower: …” (your meter\'s name with a KPower prefix) in your ride profile — don\'t also pair the meter natively, or power will be recorded twice.

This only tells KPower which source the Karoo records as power (so it isn\'t duplicated in the FIT). You still pick the actual sensor in your Karoo ride profile. Estimated needs Comparison mode on; a real meter must be added on the Comparison tab first; External means another sensor you pair directly in the Karoo.
